title: Velvety Flaky Polish Date Flatbread
description: Savory Polish flatbread filled with sweet medjool dates and creamy coconut, perfect for a snack or light lunch.
instructions: Combine warm water and yeast in a small bowl, stir to dissolve, and let sit for 5 minutes.
Mix flour, salt, and cracked black pepper in a large bowl.
Add the yeast mixture, olive oil, and coconut cream to the dry ingredients, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread the pitted medjool dates evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the dates to form a crust.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
